description: This file defines a class MapParser for processing Android build zip files to create and query file name maps based on memory addresses and partitions. It includes methods for initializing, adding maps from zip entries, and querying file names by address extents.

classes.name: MapParser
classes.description: A class for parsing Android zip builds to create address-to-file name maps and perform queries.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes MapParser with a target zip file, setting up zip reader and internal maps.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously finds and stores .map entries from the zip build.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Builds a map for a specified partition from its .map file in the zip build.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns file names corresponding to given address extents within a partition.
